how_to_apply: Visit the official ISRO website, www.isro.gov.in, between 27-08-2026 and 16-09-2026.
Complete the online registration and note the online Registration Number provided after registration for future reference.
Fill in the online application form, ensuring the e-mail ID is entered correctly and compulsorily, as hall tickets/call letters will be sent only by e-mail.
Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format and size.
Upload the SC/ST/Disability/Ex-Servicemen certificate, if applicable.
Pay the processing fee of ₹750 online via the Bharatkosh e-payment gateway using Internet Banking, UPI, or a Domestic Debit Card.
Verify all entered details carefully before final submission of the online application.

Applications are accepted only in online mode; incomplete applications or those not conforming to the notification requirements will not be entertained. Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications for the same post — where duplicate applications are submitted, only the one against which the application fee has been received within the last date will be considered.
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Appointees are liable to be posted at any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO and may be transferred at any time based on need. The number of vacancies notified is provisional; ISRO reserves the right to increase or decrease vacancies as required. ICRB/ISRO reserves the absolute right not to fill the posts, without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue. Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route from the city indicated in the online application to the interview venue; no TA is payable for the Written Test. If any information furnished online is found false, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview and TA will not be paid. Employed candidates must apply only with the knowledge and prior permission of their employer, and must submit an NOC at the time of interview; failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for interview. All further communication will be sent only through the candidate's registered e-mail ID or the ISRO website; candidates should check their e-mail regularly, including spam/junk folders. Legal matters arising from this recruitment fall under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Candidates are advised not to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO. In case of any ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version will be treated as final.

content_sections.heading: ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 175 vacancies have been notified for Scientist/Engineer 'SC' across six post codes, covering constituent ISRO Centres and the autonomous body PRL. The number of vacancies notified is tentative, and ISRO reserves the right to increase or decrease this number, with any change notified through a corrigendum on the ISRO website. An asterisk (*) against a PwBD figure denotes a backlog vacancy. If suitable PwBD candidates are not available in a notified disability category, the vacancy may be filled by interchange among the five PwBD categories (A to E), and if no suitable PwBD candidate is available at all, the post will be filled by a candidate other than a person with disability.

content_sections.heading: ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 is assessed on educational qualification, nationality, and age as on 16-09-2026. The notification clarifies that graduation must be completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university. Allied disciplines acceptable under each stream are listed in the FAQs published on the ISRO website (not detailed in this notification). Where a university's certificate mentions both CGPA and percentage, at least one criterion must meet ISRO's eligibility norms; where only CGPA is mentioned, that CGPA itself must meet the norm, and conversion of CGPA to percentage is not permitted for determining eligibility (and vice versa where only percentage is mentioned). Separate rules for Dual/Integrated Degree programmes are also specified in the notification. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

rows.required_qualification: BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Electronics & Communication Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10
BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10
BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10

content_sections.heading: ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit: 28 years as on 16-09-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for serving Central Government civilian employees, Ex-servicemen, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per Government of India orders (specific relaxation figures are not specified in this notification). Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 is based on a Written Test/CBT followed by an Interview. The Written Test/CBT carries a total of 100 marks and will be conducted at 37 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam. ICRB reserves the right to change or cancel a test venue and reallot candidates to another centre. Based on Written Test/CBT performance, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio, with an aggregate minimum of 10 candidates. For reserved vacancies, distinct/additional candidates are shortlisted separately in the 1:5 ratio. For the final panel, 50% weightage is given to Written Test/CBT marks and 50% to Interview marks. In case of a tie, inter-se merit is decided in order by marks in the Written Test/CBT, marks in the essential qualification, and then date of birth (older candidates placed higher).

faq.question: Q1. What is ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by ISRO, through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board, for 175 posts of Scientist/Engineer 'SC' in Electronics, Mechanical, and Computer Science, under Advt No. ISRO:ICRB:03(EMC):2026 dated 27-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 175 vacancies are notified: 99 for Electronics, 52 for Mechanical, 21 for Computer Science at constituent ISRO Centres, and 1 each for Electronics, Mechanical, and Computer Science at the autonomous body PRL.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the application fee is 16-09-2026 (11:55 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science Engineering (as applicable to the post), with a minimum of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10, is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 16-09-2026, with age relaxation for serving Central Government employees, Ex-servicemen, and PwBD candidates as per Government of India orders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates must initially pay ₹750 as a processing fee. Of this, ₹250 is a non-refundable application fee; the remaining ₹500 (or the full amount for women, SC/ST/PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen) is refunded to candidates who appear in the Written Test/CBT.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online at www.isro.gov.in between 27-08-2026 and 16-09-2026 by completing registration, filling the application form, uploading the required documents, and paying the processing fee through the Bharatkosh e-payment gateway.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Written Test/CBT (Part A: discipline-specific, Part B: aptitude), followed by shortlisting for Interview in a 1:5 ratio, with the final panel based on 50% weightage to Written Test/CBT marks and 50% to Interview marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are placed in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month, plus DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the ISRO Scientist Engineer SC posts be located?
faq.answer: Appointees may be posted at any constituent ISRO Centre/Unit under the Department of Space, or at the autonomous body PRL, and are liable to be transferred to any Centre/Unit at any time based on need.
